title: Couple in Halloween Costumes with Black Cat, 1954 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot taken on October 30, 1954, capturing a couple identified on the back as Ed and Bert sitting on a basement floor near wooden stairs during a Halloween Eve celebration. The man is wearing a fur-legged costume while holding a black cat, and the woman is clad in a white toga dress. The festive atmosphere of mid-century American home celebrations is highlighted by streamers decorating the basement columns.
